mapper.select: SELECT OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, MEMBER_CODE as memberCode, ACTIVITY_NAME as activityName, PROFILE_IMAGE as profileImage, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION as creatorIntroduction, ACTIVITY_REGION as activityRegion FROM ( SELECT OPERATOR_CODE, MEMBER_CODE, ACTIVITY_NAME, PROFILE_IMAGE, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION, ACTIVITY_REGION FROM CREATOR WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CREATOR_INTRODUCTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY OPERATOR_CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CLASS_CODE as classCode, OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode, NAME as name, PRICE as price, DESIRED_PRICE as desiredPrice, ADDRESS as address, SINGLE_INTRODUCE as singleIntroduce, STAR_RATING_AVG as starRatingAvg, (SELECT ci.IMAGE FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = CLASS.CLASS_CODE AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS WHERE STATUS = '모집중' AND (NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR INTRODUCE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CLASS_CODE IN ( SELECT CLASS_CODE FROM TAG WHERE TAG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )) ORDER BY CLASS_CODE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4

SELECT OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, MEMBER_CODE as memberCode, ACTIVITY_NAME as activityName, PROFILE_IMAGE as profileImage, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION as creatorIntroduction, ACTIVITY_REGION as activityRegion FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, c.* FROM ( SELECT OPERATOR_CODE, MEMBER_CODE, ACTIVITY_NAME, PROFILE_IMAGE, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION, ACTIVITY_REGION FROM CREATOR WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CREATOR_INTRODUCTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY OPERATOR_CODE DESC ) c WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endNum} ) WHERE rnum >= #{startNum}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, c.* FROM ( SELECT CLASS_CODE as classCode, OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode, NAME as name, PRICE as price, DESIRED_PRICE as desiredPrice, ADDRESS as address, SINGLE_INTRODUCE as singleIntroduce, STAR_RATING_AVG as starRatingAvg, (SELECT ci.IMAGE FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = CLASS.CLASS_CODE AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS WHERE STATUS = '모집중' AND (NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR INTRODUCE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CLASS_CODE IN ( SELECT CLASS_CODE FROM TAG WHERE TAG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )) ORDER BY CLASS_CODE DESC ) c WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endNum} ) WHERE rnum >= #{startNum}

SELECT CLASS_CODE as classCode, NAME as name, PRICE as price, DESIRED_PRICE as desiredPrice, ADDRESS as address, (SELECT ci.IMAGE FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = CLASS.CLASS_CODE AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{operatorCode} AND STATUS = '모집중' ORDER BY CLASS_CODE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS WHERE STATUS = '모집중' AND (NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR INTRODUCE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CLASS_CODE IN ( SELECT CLASS_CODE FROM TAG WHERE TAG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CREATOR WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CREATOR_INTRODUCTION LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
SELECT CLASS_IMG_CODE as classImgCode, CLASS_CODE as classCode, TYPE as type, IMAGE as image, SORT_ORDER as sortOrder FROM CLASS_IMG WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
